classification: A distinct normal-dynamics proposal after the global and physically gated magnitude proposals were falsified on normal-only data. Neither rejected proposal is retuned.

rejected_predecessors.v2_failure: Even after causal payload-settle and table-geometry gates, normal vertical deceleration produced 19.701 N eight-sample and 16.521 N 32-sample 3D changes, yielding thresholds above the weak-force class.

mechanism: Fit signed normal vertical-to-horizontal coupling from force-free episodes. For each lag, ordinary least squares predicts the two-axis horizontal force change from [1, vertical force change]. Detection uses only the signed two-axis residual that normal vertical dynamics do not explain.

physical_eligibility.ineligible_behavior: Reset onset, pending, pulse, ownership, and history immediately.

formal_fit_rule.fit_only: Pool every eligible fit sample. Independently for lags 8 and 32, solve numpy.linalg.lstsq on design [1, delta_fz] and response [delta_fx, delta_fy] with rcond=None.
formal_fit_rule.onset_threshold: 1.05 * maximum Euclidean onset residual norm over fit + 0.05 N.
formal_fit_rule.sustain_threshold: 1.05 * maximum Euclidean 32-sample residual norm over fit + 0.05 N.
formal_fit_rule.audit_use: Audit validates the frozen coefficients and thresholds only; it never changes them.

fixed_event_rule.coherence: Successive signed onset residual vectors must have positive dot product.
fixed_event_rule.ownership: Continuous sustain residual projection owns rearming only. It never holds the alarm output. A live native R26 report suppresses the extra pulse for that sample and cancels a still-pending extra.

normal_falsifiers: Any candidate-only alarm in any fit or disjoint audit normal episode.
Any nonfinite or rank-deficient two-column fit design.
Any audit-driven coefficient, threshold, lag, gate, or state-machine change.
Any passive-capture difference from the frozen R26 physical/native baseline.
forced_gate_deferred: Only after passing normals, unit tests, candidate/model freeze, and forced-protocol fingerprint may disclosed target/control forces run. The independent challenge is presealed and remains unread.
